issues.desc: checklist CHK-002 context tells the implementer to consult "checklist.ts evidence-pin seatbelt (receipt_selector_mismatch) and the generated hook's source" -- but a repo-wide grep for receipt_selector_mismatch / selectorMatched / VerificationExecutionReceipt shows the evidence-pin seatbelt lives only in packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts, packages/main/src/core/types.ts, packages/main/src/core/verification.ts, and two smoke-test files under packages/main/src/tasks/; the only "generated hook" matches in the repo (packages/main/src/init-assets.ts:592,733) are the Claude/Codex scope-guard pretool hooks, an unrelated subsystem. The reference to "the generated hook's source" appears to be a copy-paste artifact and could send the implementer to the wrong file for a security-adjacent gate change.
